classificationLegend.CANDIDATE_DIAGNOSTIC_ACTION: An action to inspect or test; it does not assert a fault or change the design until the user applies it.
classificationLegend.EXPLANATION_ONLY: Informational text; no action, fault claim or repair.
classificationLegend.VERIFIED_CORRECTION: Re-applying this exact edit was re-compared in the fixture and restored equivalence to the selected reference; it is not absolute proof of intended behavior.

llmOracleNote: No language model is used as a proof or fault oracle in this corpus.
